rationale: All six citations remain attached to distinct propositions, so no forbidden move occurred. However, every background claim was strengthened: “can increase” became “narrows” and “broaden”; “may shape” became “shapes”; “can improve” became “improves”; “has…been associated with” became “supports”; and “may signal” became “signals.” R-1 authorized condensation, not removal of these hedges. The final sentence also newly claims that replies and tone “appear to work through” specific pathways; R-2 authorized a stronger conceptual link, but not a new mechanistic interpretation of the associations.
